answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 29086 Country: India Title: If a man is seriously ill by cold and doctor suggest him to take a small quantity of liquor and patient took relief by liquor so it is right according to our religion or not? Question: if a man is seriously ill by cold and doctor suggest him to take a small quantity of liquor and patient took relief by liquor so it is right according to our religion or not? Answer ID: 29086 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 146/146/M=1432) There are too many lawful and halal medicines available for the treatment of cold. It is unlawful to treat with unlawful items when lawful items are available. According to Shariah, wine is haram. It is not lawful to use it but in severely exigent cases. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
